items.headline: Saratoga Springs man accused of selling meth at Saratoga Race Course
items.excerpt: Two Saratoga County residents have been arrested in separate narcotics investigations, according to the Saratoga Springs Police Department.

items.headline: Driver with 43 license suspensions arrested after Malta crash: SCSO
items.excerpt: A Schenectady man, who had 43 suspensions on 10 separate dates for failing to answer summonses, is suspected of leaving the scene of a property-damage collision on U.S. Route 9 in Malta.

items.headline: Troy sushi restaurant closes, new location in works nearby
items.excerpt: A sushi restaurant in downtown Troy has closed its doors after nine years in business.

items.headline: Beyond Nutrition in Glenville to close storefront
items.excerpt: Beyond Nutrition in Glenville announced on Wednesday that they will be closing their Saratoga Road storefront at the end of the year.

items.headline: New Mexican restaurant opens in Amsterdam
items.excerpt: A new Mexican restaurant has opened its doors in the town of Amsterdam. Tequila Casa Azul Mexican Restaurant opened at the end of October in Perth Plaza at 4879 Route 30.

items.headline: Schenectady County approves expanded property tax exemptions
items.excerpt: The Schenectady County Legislature announced on Tuesday that two local laws have been approved that will expand property tax exemptions for multiple groups in the community.
